Messages.Author: Henrik Klippstr?m
Messages.Body:
Hi again kids. Built my own version of Erik Torstenssons "Die
Kuchenfrau goes mad"-deck. Sure, Earth Meld is cheaper than Majesty,
but good old archbishop determines range all by himself, and Using the
advantage enables niiiiiice bloating. Slow setup. OK, this is not a
TWD, but it works better than I thought. You try - you might like.

Deck: The Motorcity Madman
Crypt: 12
4 Cailean
2 Victoria
1 Evan Klein
1 Jeremy Talbot
1 Adelaide Davis
1 Milo the Invisible Horror
1 Zoe
1 Watenda

Library: 90
Masters: 24
3 Blood Doll
4 Madness Network
6 Using the advantage
3 Smiling Jack
2 Information Network
2 Parthenon
1 Pentex Subversion
1 Nosferatu Kingdom
1 Shanty Town HG
1 Dreams of the Sfinx
1 Elder Library (Dreams tend to contest.)

Actions: 14
12 Night Moves
2 Eternal Vigilance (Dangerous with Majesty. Make sure to doll him and
bloat.)

Eq: 5
2 Sport Bike
1 Assault Rifle
1 Ivory Bow
1 Flamethrower

Action modifier: 16
4 Cloak the gathering
2 Lost in crowds
3 Faceless Night
2 Swallowed by the night
3 Spying Mission
2 Elder Impersonation

Combat: 15
15 Majesty

Reactions: 15
10 Forced Awakening
3 Cat´s Guidance
2 Deflection

Sure. If your are in a hurry.

> > 2 Eternal Vigilance (Dangerous with Majesty. Make sure to doll him and

> dolling him costs pool...

Yeah, but you HAVE to. Both Vigilance and Majesty cost blood.

> > 2 Sport Bike

> > 3 Cat´s Guidance

Mmmm. I will also try.

> doesn't this deck run low on pool pretty fast? u got alot of masters
> that cost pool and the Eq isn't helping with it's cost....even if u
> get madness network and using the advantage it doesn't look like that
> alone has what it takes to keep up with what this deck "cost"...

The idea is to get out Cailean+big scary gun rather fast. That way
people (all people not with alot of stealth that is) stays away. Then
put out 1 Malkavian, then Madness Network and 1-2-3-4-5-6 Using the
advantage. With Victoria this could lead to 2-7 bloat every turn (even
more with Kingdom and HG), which should be enough to fuel Cailean, put
out some more Malks, and, in the late game, Jack.

> what if someone tryes to remove the network, would u realy have the
> intersept u need?

This is, of course a problem. I play 2 Info Networks (to get one
early), and with a bike (or retainer, if you prefer), you can handle
most low-stealth decks. But a dedicated stealther sure does succeed.

> I could be wrong since I haven't tryed the deck, but are u usaly high
> on pool?

With a good draw I get the bloat going after a while.

> Don't get me wrong I think the idè behind it is cool, but just looks

> like the deck uses alot of pool.

It does.
